departments.name: lab
departments.title: The Lab (server and chunk reader)
departments.plain: Starts the real Minecraft 1.16.1 server with no game client, sends it commands, reads its saved chunks back as blocks, and shuts it down cleanly.

residents_skills.why: write the least code that passes

RED test first, then the fix

nurses_skills.why: read logs, grep, collect command output verbatim
check each claim about the server against its log
re-derive byte offsets and counts by hand
find leaked java processes and stuck ports
